item.content:encoded:
Organization: Open Networked Earth (O.N.E.)

Status: searching

Compensation: gratis

Role: Video & Storytelling

Open Networked Earth (O.N.E.) is an open-source, post-enclosure civilizational architecture designed to replace predatory debt and resource speculation with thermodynamic conservation and demarchic sortition.

Unlike theoretical proposals or crypto projects, the foundational groundwork is fully codified:

  • An 11-chapter Living Constitution (dynamic usufruct & sortition lotteries).
  • A thermodynamic Leontief input-output engine balancing real exergy (kWh) and dry mass (kg).
  • A scientific discrete-event simulation engine in Julia (SIMONE).
  • Physical open-hardware blueprints for islanded microgrids and modular CNC timber habitats (WikiHouse compatible).
  • 6 completed novels and full audiobooks.

The Operational Bottleneck & Inversion:

I can write the mathematical equations, maintain the Julia models, and draft constitutional mechanics, but I cannot simultaneously produce video edits, manage daily community triage, and run social channels.

We are seeking an active Media, Storytelling & Video Co-Steward (Pillar 0) to join as a peer foundational partner (Co-Founder tier). You will take full operational co-ownership of how O.N.E. communicates with the world, turning rigorous scientific and legal models into compelling cultural narratives.

Under our governance model, each domain pillar requires a quorum of 3 Active Co-Stewards with equal voting weight. You will have full creative freedom within our non-commercial invariants.

What We Offer (Pre-Rendered Assets):

You do not start from a blank slate. You inherit an extensive catalog:

  • 6 full novels + complete audiobooks on Internet Archive.
  • Master 4K cinematic video renders, 3D animated timelines, and orchestral scores.
  • 336 multilingual comic panels across 14 languages.
  • Interactive WebGL simulation sandbox.

How to Apply:

  • Introduce yourself and share creative work in GitHub Discussion #13:
  • https://github.com/kyberlex/ONE/discussions/13
  • Or reach out asynchronously via email:
  • kyberlex@proton.me
